//go:build postingedgebench && darwin

package postingedge

import (
	"encoding/binary"
	"encoding/json"
	"os"
	"syscall"
	"testing"
	"unsafe"

	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
)

// TestZZWritten runs after TestIntegrationScale in the same process (the
// file name sorts last) and writes to PE_RUSAGE what the system accounted to
// the process so far (proc_pid_rusage, RUSAGE_INFO_V2): the bytes it wrote to
// and read from disk, and its page-ins. The same file builds at every point
// of the regression check of 2026-11-27 (bench-report.md).
func TestZZWritten(t *testing.T) {
	out := os.Getenv("PE_RUSAGE")
	if out == "" {
		t.Skip("no PE_RUSAGE given")
	}
	const procInfoCallPidRusage, rusageInfoV2 = 9, 2
	var buf [256]byte
	_, _, errno := syscall.Syscall6(syscall.SYS_PROC_INFO, procInfoCallPidRusage, uintptr(os.Getpid()), rusageInfoV2, 0,
		uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(&buf[0])), 0)
	require.Zero(t, errno, "proc_pid_rusage")
	word := func(i int) uint64 { return binary.LittleEndian.Uint64(buf[16+8*i:]) }
	raw, err := json.MarshalIndent(map[string]uint64{
		"pageins": word(4), "diskBytesRead": word(16), "diskBytesWritten": word(17),
	}, "", "  ")
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.NoError(t, os.WriteFile(out, raw, 0o644))
	t.Logf("written to disk %.1f MB, read %.1f MB", float64(word(17))/1e6, float64(word(16))/1e6)
}
